services.value: Provides environmental and industrial hygiene testing including asbestos bulk sample analysis (Polarized Light Microscopy) and air sample analysis (Phase Contrast Microscopy), plus air analysis, bulk analysis, and trace/priority pollutant metals analysis (including hexavalent chromium). Also offers industrial hygiene testing for lead, formaldehyde, PCBs, hydrocarbons, silica, and asbestos; microbiology/mold analysis (identification of spores and evaluation of debris) and bacteria analysis in water (E-coli and Total Coliform).
